name: Connect Four
tagline: Drop a disc. Connect four. Play the computer, or a friend on the other side.
description:
A seven-column board. Red and blue take turns dropping a disc. First to get four in a line — across, down, or diagonal — wins.

On your own you play a computer that looks a few moves ahead, on this device. There is no game server. Pass the phone for two people in the same room, or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same board, live, on two devices. Red sits one side, blue the other. Tap a column to drop.

An unofficial port of c4 by kenrick95. The computer is the same one that shipped with that game.
